verdict.rationale: Appwrite runs the whole backend stack, including auth, databases, storage and functions, on any machine with a Docker CLI. The CLI targets that local instance via `--endpoint`, Functions are pitched as "develop locally, deploy when ready," and migration between self-hosted and Cloud is supported. Community users confirm the containerized setup makes offline development and testing easier and that it is easy to self-install for home projects. missing for 10: a dedicated local-dev emulator or local-to-cloud deploy workflow (self-hosting docs are framed around production infrastructure), hands-on evidence of local Functions development in detail.
